correct_completion: we missed the first half of the meeting.
full_sentence: Because the train was delayed, we missed the first half of the meeting.
acceptable_variants: we arrived late to the meeting.
we had to wait at the station.

options.text: we ordered a coffee while we waited.
options.why_wrong: This describes an action, but it does not show the result of the delay that 'because' requires.

options.text: we missed the first half of the meeting.
so we took the train yesterday.
options.why_wrong: This refers to a different time and does not explain a result of the delay.

options.text: we were happy with the seats.
options.why_wrong: This is a feeling about the seats and is not a logical result of the train being delayed.

explanation: After 'because', the sentence needs a main clause that shows the result of the cause given in the first part. Spanish learners sometimes forget that English needs a full result clause after this connector.
translation: Como el tren se retrasó, perdimos la primera mitad de la reunión.
